_scheme: TX = decision at Space (stream Transformer); RV = reviser that may change a word once more words are typed; a variant of one version gets a suffix (TX4-lr3). left / right: words of context before / after a word that the model is built for (null = the whole input). split_threshold / act_threshold: tuned on the dev sets for that model (split a word whose best path changes language when its probability is at least this; decide at Space when sure at least this, else after one more word); missing = code defaults. nunchi/models.py loads a model by name from here. TR = one model that decides at Space and revises (full window, every word labelled). Suffixes: -long = 51k training steps, -xlong = 102k (default 17k for TX/RV); short_* = 10k-step screening runs (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md). digits: own key ids for 0-9 (models trained on the v2/v3 pools that keep numbers); data: training pools (v1: numbers removed, v3: numbers kept, code-only web lines thinned); parent: the model it changes; steps: training steps.
